༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs nas rje rin po che sogs la brgyud pa'i 'jam lugs tshe dpag lha lnga'i rjes gnang bzhugs/bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs nas rje rin po che sogs la brgyud pa'i

'jam lugs tshe dpag lha lnga'i rjes gnang bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rje rin po che nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med lha lnga'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang bya tshul la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam pa can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i tshe dpag med spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa zhes pa nas/ spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i sprul sku tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ a pa ra mi ta ā ur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /sdig pa'i dri ma phyir bsam nas/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rigs bdag tshe dpag med kyi phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar snying po dang gzungs ring gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

rang gi tshe mi ma yin gyis 'phrog pa dang*/ brkus pa dang*/ yar ba la sogs pa rnams bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ yang 'byung ba dang 'byung gyur rnams kyi bcud dang*/ skye 'phags thams cad kyi tshe dpal bsod nams dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa'i nang gang bas bdud rtsi dkar chil gyis lus nas rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs pas/ lus kyi nang gang*/ dri ma dag 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur par bsams la/ a ma ra ṇi dang*/ gzungs ring bzla/ mjug tu yig brgya dang*/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya'o/ /de nas tshe dbang bya ba la mdun bskyed bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ tshe bum bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ tshe bum stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las bum pa dmar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba brgyan cing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyi bum pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de rnams kyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po'i ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa re re/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi gdan la sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa/ shar du 'khor lo'i rigs kyi tshe dpag med/ lhor rin po che'i rigs kyi tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma'i rigs kyi tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi rigs kyi tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/

/zhes sogs sngar bzhin dang*/ spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga zhes sbyar nas mchod bstod par sngar bzhin bya/ bzlas pa ni/ bum pa'i nang gi tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ bum pa'i nang du zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar snying po dang gzungs ring nas slob ma rnams kyi tshe yar ba dang 'thor ba la sogs pa rnams bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ bar bsams la/ gzungs gnyis ci grub bzla/ tshe chang nang mchod ltar rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas gzungs gnyis bzla zhing*/ tshe ril ni/ hrīḥlas tshe ril rnams sman sna tshogs las grub pa'i ril bur gyur pa'i steng du hrīḥyig de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i byin rlabs dang sman dang rtsi bcud la sogs pa'i nus pa thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas tshe ril la thim par bsams la gzungs gnyis bzlas te bsgrubs/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gong gi sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba ling ta zhes sogs btags nas 'bul zhing*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la bstod/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas la mdun du 'khod pa la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du 'jug /de nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol 'debs lan gsum byed du gzhug de nas chos bshad pa spyi dang bye brag gis gdams pa 'di'i lo rgyus brjod/ de nas/ gnas khang 'di tha mal gyi rang bzhin can ma yin par dag pa'i zhing mdun gyi bum pa'i nang du tshe dpag med rigs lnga dngos su bzhugs pa'i mos pa dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas rnams bzhugs pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas byang sdom 'dzin pa'i ched du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug

de nas/ slob dpon rin po che bdag la mgon po tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsum gsol gdab byas kyang legs/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bstan pa ni/ mdun gyi bum pa 'di nang lha'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ de'i nang gi dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje'i tshe dpag med/ /zhes pa nas/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par mos/ de nas slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla gdan la slob ma'i sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdamar po de yongs su gyur pa las slob ma rnams tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ zhes sogs gnas gsum byin brlab bya/ de nas dbang bskur ba dngos la/ tshe bum la brten nas dbang bskur ba/ tshe chang la brten nas= /tshe ril la brten nas= /tshe spel ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la tshe yar ba 'gug pa/ nyams pa gso ba/ tshe bstim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang gi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi hrīḥyig gi mthar snying po dang gzungs ring gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe gshin rje dang rgyal po la sogs pa mi ma yin rnams kyi 'phrog pa dang*/ brkus pa/ yar ba/ 'thor ba thams cad bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus kyi nang gang phyi thams cad bkrus pas/ lus gnod pa gang gis mi tshugs pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces brjod nas ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra dang bcas/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di rnams 'di dag la tshe dbang du gyur cigatshe dngos grub tu gyur cig

tshe mi 'gyur ba'i g.yu drung du gyur cig mi gzhig pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur cig cig ces brjod la me tog gtor/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gis zhes sogs lta bu'i bkra shis bya'o/ / gnyis pa nyams pa gso ba la/ tshe nyams pa gso ba/ stobs dang bsod nams nyams pa gso ba/ dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa gso ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang gi zhes pa nas/ 'od zer 'phros/ 'byung ba nam mkha' rlung me dang chu dang sa'i bcud thams cad bdud rtsi ljang khu dang sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po dang ser po'i rnam par nam mkha'i khams gang bar bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhes pa nas/ dag par bkrus pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag khyad par du yang 'byung ba'i sgo nas tshe nyams pa'i nyes skyon sbyangs nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cigasngags ring thung gnyis ka'am/ a ma ra ṇi gnyis ka brjod de/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di dag la tshe dbang du gyur cig sogs sngar bzhin dang chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du zhes sogs lta bu'i bkra shis bya'o/ / gnyis pa stobs dang bsod nams nyams pa gso ba ni/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i zhes pa nas/ 'od zer 'phraus/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa lha tshe ring po rnams dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa mi tshe ring po rnams dang*/ dga' bo dang nye dga' la sogs pa'i klu tshe ring po rnams dang*/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku tshe bsod nams dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi phun tshogs thams cad dang*/ de rnams kyi bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/

rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad la sogs pa'i rnam par bkug nas sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhes pa nas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag khyad par du yang stobs dang bsod nams nyams pa'i nyes skyon sbyangs/ stobs dang bsod nams nyams pa sor chud/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /ces dang*/ a ma ra ṇi dang*/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu zhes sogs dang*/ ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /zhes sogs bkra shis bya'o/ /gsum pa dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams la gso ba ni/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i zhes pa nas/ 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med la sogs pa tshe 'khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang*/ lha mi'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams kyi sku gsung thugs ky-i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad sku gzugs dang yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam par bkug nas sngags phreng la thim/ zhes pa nas/ sdig sgrib dgakhyad par du yang dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa'i nyes skyon sbyangs/ dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi med nas/ snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig a ma ra ṇi dang*/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu zhes sogs dang*/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi zhes sogs bkra shis bya'o/ /gsum pa tshe bstim pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ nub phyogs bde ba can nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med la tshe 'khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ bum nang gi tshe dpag med rnams la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ khyed rnam pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang tshe dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur nas 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig

ces brjod nas tshe bum slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grub mchog chos kyi rdo rje/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang sbyin pa'i bar gyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs shig gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad kyis byin gyis=/ khyed rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di dag la gnod pa'i nad gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa'i gnod pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du tshe la bar du gcod pa'i mi ma yin gyi gnod pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las srungs shig skyobs shig /ces dang*/ gzungs ring thung gnyis tshar gcig bzla'o/ /tshe chang la brten nas dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe chang 'di nyid bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs shing*/ de'i steng du yi ge gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams bkug nas de la thim par gyur/ de lta bu'i bdud rtsi de nyid gsol bas lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi med nas/ mos pa mdzod cig dam rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zas/ de ring bu yis btung bar bgyis/ /nga yis bsgos pa'i bka' ma bcag /sgrub la nan tan gces su gyis/ /zhes tshe chang sbyin/ gsum pa tshe ril la brten nas dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe ril 'di nyid kyang byang sems kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sman dang rtsi bcud kyi nus pa rnams bkug nas bstims nas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/

'di gsol bas gdon dang nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la sogs pa thams cad zhi nas 'chi med nas mdzod cig bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyis zas/ /snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni/ /de ring bu yis bza' bar bgyis/ /'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /zhal zas bsten na nad kun las/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /bzhi pa tshe spel ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar rgyal ba tshe dpag med la tshe 'khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ lha mi'i rig 'dzin gyi tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyis shis pa brjod par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mang ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas zhes sogs so sor ram/ yang na/ phyin drug stobs kyis zhes sogs thun mong du bya zhing*/ gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs dang*/ de nas gtang rang gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mjug chog rnams spyi ltar bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis dam pa snga ma'i bshad srol ltar bgyis so/ / maṅgalaṃ// // yang grub rgyal ma'i lugs kyi rjes gnang la tshe dpag med lha lnga'i snon ma btab nas dbang bskur ba'i tshul zhig 'byung ba 'di sgos su byas na'ang legs 'dug pas 'di ltar bya ste/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdamar po de yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

de'i thugs kar pad ma 'dab ma bzhi bzla gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ nas/ skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hrīḥ'am hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i nas 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nas/ chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las sprul sku tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa/ oṃ ār+ya a pa ra mi ta sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ a ma ra ṇi dang*/ oṃ bud+dha ā yu dzñā na sid+dhi sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes pa gnyis dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ rat+na ā yu dzñā na dang*/ pad+ma ā yu dzñā na dang*/ karmāḥ.ā yu dzñā na zhes sbyar ba bzlas nas yig brgya brjod cing*/ mchod bstod bya/ de nas bum pa'i nang du tshe dpag med rigs lnga bskyed rgyu byung na legs mod/ 'dir ma bskyed kyang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ ༈ /stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la slob ma tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa'i snying khar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan re re/ /zhes brjod de/ slob dpon rin po che bdag la tshe dpag med rig lnga'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs su gzhugade nas/ rang gi snying khar bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med rigs lnga las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas slob ma'i snying khar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir bzhugs par gyur pa ni/

dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig nas rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i zla gdan la hrīḥ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rnam snang dang rnam snang gi rigs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus kyi cha thams cad nas zhugs snying kha'i rnam snang tshe dpag med la thim pas/ lus kyi nang gang*/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dang de la brten nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon dang bcas pa thams cad zhi bar byas/ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa yon tan thams cad rgyas shing*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /ces brda sprad nas/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las rgyal te/ bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /ces brjod de rdo rje slob ma'i snying khar bzhag bum pa chu yod na gtor bzhin par/ oṃ bud+dha ā yu dzñā na sogs kyi sngags brjod/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang hrīḥzhes pa nas/ 'phros pas mi bskyod pa dang de'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rdo rje tshe dpag med la thim pas/ zhes pa nas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang de la brten nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i zhes pa nas/ lus la rdo rje tshe dbang bskur/

zhes pa nas/ rdo rje snying khar 'jog pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥdzñā na zhes sogs kyi sngags brjod/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i rin chen tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang hrīḥzhes pa nas/ rin chen dang rin chen gyi rigs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rin chen tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rin chen tshe dpag med la thim pas/ zhes pa nas/ nyon mongs pa ser sna dang de la brten nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib zhes pa nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i zhes pa nas/ lus la rin chen tshe dbang bskur/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ rat+na ā yuḥdzñā na sogs kyi sngags brjod/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang hrīḥzhes pa nas/ pad+ma dang pad+ma'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ pad+ma tshe dpag med la thim pas/ /zhes pa nas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang de la brten nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib zhes pa nas/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i zhes pa nas/ lus la pad+ma'i tshe dbang bskur/ /zhes pa nas/ oṃ pad+ma ā yuḥdzñā na sogs kyi sngags brjod/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i las kyi tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang hrīḥzhes pa nas/ 'phrin las dang 'phrin las kyi rigs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad las kyi tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ las kyi tshe dpag med la thim pas/ zhes pa nas/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog dang de la brten nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i zhes pa nas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lus la las kyi tshe dbang bskur/ /zhes pa nas/ oṃ karmāḥ.ā yu dzña na zhes sogs kyi sngags brjod/ de ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ bsdu na/ /snying kha'i tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i hrīḥ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phraus pas/

rigs lnga dang de'i rigs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga la thim pas/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas slob ma'i lus kyi nang gang*/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga dang de la brten nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib zhes pa nas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lus la rigs lnga'i tshe dbang bskur/ /zhes sogs brjod cing*/ rdo rje 'jog pa dang*/ sngags de rnams brjod/ 'di grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang dang sbyar nas byed na/ bka' bsgo'i gong der bya bar bshad la/ sgos su byed na/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /zhes sogs kyi bkra shis dang*/ yang na/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /zhes sogs ci rigs bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung gi man ngag la brten nas gzhan re gnyis la phan shas che snyam ste bshad sgrub ming can gyis bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni ta yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo// //maṅgalaṃ// //
